name: Proj Dtl
query:
SELECT 
    project.project_customer AS project_customer,
    project.task AS task,
    project.sla_class AS sla_class,
    project.work_team AS work_team,
    project.team_leader AS team_leader,
    user.full_name AS team_leader_name,
    project.project__object_size_in_hecter AS object_size_hecter,
    project.project__object_price_per_hecter AS price_per_hecter,
    project.status AS status,
    project.project_name AS project_name
FROM 
    tabProject Setup project
LEFT JOIN 
    tabUser user ON project.team_leader = user.name
GROUP BY 
    project.project_customer, project.task, project.sla_class, project.work_team, 
    project.team_leader, user.full_name, 
    project.project__object_size_in_hecter, project.project__object_price_per_hecter,
    project.status, project.project_name
ORDER BY 
    project.project_customer, project.task;
